goal: Two continuous engineering packages with three complete outcomes each: ordinary project declaration and original delivery; migration re-identification, post-restore re-registration and same-version hand-off.

outcomes.title: production applicability of ordinary Node/npm/pnpm declarations
implementation: note when a declared manager has no lockfile: actionable gap, no guessed install/command
outcomes.actualConsumer: main preview (POST /v1/projects/:id/recipes/preview) + original NewWorkForm; fields from the same server projection
positive: plain Node, npm and pnpm single packages get drafts for all three kinds
scope atoms, exclusions and expiry are preserved from the current project configuration
independentNegative: undeclared atom -> needs_input with fields null; unknown project -> forbidden
symlink / non-regular / oversized / invalid-limit reads are refused; missing lock is a note, not an invented command
scripts remain names-only data; no install/run/register
remaining: real monorepo member unsupported stays needs_input/unsupported by design

outcomes.title: two original projects: complete delivery and repairable failure loop
positive: two independent roots: preview -> create -> product attempt -> check/candidate -> ready -> manual accept -> delivered
artifact bytes readable and verified; reopen of the same state shows the delivered work again
missing atom repaired by choosing a declared atom, then delivered; config revision change re-reads into a fresh applicable draft
switching projects never carries the other project's draft; both still deliver
independentNegative: accept is not offered before readiness; an early attempt is refused for that reason
a cross-project candidate is rejected; replaying an accepted candidate is a stale refusal only after a legal accept
reusing a commandId with a different body is refused as conflict, not silently duplicated
remaining: controlled fixture protocol only: real vendor/model/native turns remain 0
a real check-FAIL oracle is not reachable in fixture mode (E/main own the real verifier); not claimed as exercised

outcomes.title: explainable revalidation under config and metadata change
outcomes.actualConsumer: main/F can render structured reasons; previewInputs keeps the established error contract
positive: stable content digest excludes observation time: re-reading unchanged bytes stays current
every cause has one closed code: configuration version/schema/revision/removal, facts invalid/changed/future/expired, expiry, clock
independentNegative: a future or expired observation, an invalid clock, a removed project or an expired scope is never treated as current
observationComplete=false when the current facts have missing/omissions, so 'no content change' is not reported as complete
remaining: main still owns the fresh server clock and the registered root; J never accepts injected arbitrary facts from a public request

outcomes.title: project re-identification on a current registration basis
outcomes.actualConsumer: main's own `{ rootFor }` mapping (one call); CLI `--previous-facts`
positive: same id on a new root with changed content -> changed with field-level differences
same content in a new root -> current, with an explicit note that the root identity is the caller's to verify
different id with identical content -> reidentified (changes empty) and explicitly not reusable
independentNegative: no registered root -> unbound (exit 3), never a guessed path
an authorized-root violation (e.g. '/') is an error, not unbound
malformed previous facts or invalid clock is refused; the report carries no root, key or grant
remaining: main has not imported rebind.ts; no default migration page exists yet

outcomes.title: re-registration after a non-empty restore keeps original history
outcomes.actualConsumer: same ProductStore/Application/runtime; the operator restarts the product and registers the moved root through main's registry
positive: delivered work, its candidate and every artifact byte survive the reopen under the original project id
the moved root is registered as a new project id and gets its own fresh draft
independentNegative: the old draft cannot be applied to the new identity (stale facts)
rebind reports reidentified with previousProjectId; the old result is not reused as new permission
remaining: true A/D backup/restore bytes and the frozen cohort are external; J only proves the data identity path on a real reopened store

outcomes.title: maintainable release and colleague hand-off
outcomes.actualConsumer: CLI, main and D lists can compare the same module identity; H/E read the bounded report fields
positive: describeProjectRecipes() is deterministic and reports contracts, catalog digest, vocabularies, capabilities and package version
independentNegative: capabilities let a consumer detect an older package without rebind instead of calling a missing surface
the description carries no path, credential or authority field
remaining: npm pack --dry-run is a content listing, not proof of a deployable product
D freezes the successor; E binds one exact tar
